sections.title: Call to Rebuild the Temple
sections.description: God rebukes the people and calls them to rebuild the temple

sections.title: The Future Glory of the Temple
sections.description: Promises concerning the temple's glory, teaching on purity, and the promise to Zerubbabel

events.title: The Call to Rebuild the Temple
events.description: On the first day of the sixth month in the second year of King Darius, the word of the Lord came through the prophet Haggai to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the high priest. God rebukes the people for living in paneled houses while the house of the Lord lies in ruins. He points out that they sow much but harvest little, and urges them to go up into the hills, bring down timber, and rebuild the temple.

events.title: The People Obey and Begin the Work
events.description: Zerubbabel, Joshua, and all the remnant of the people hear the voice of the Lord and the words of the prophet Haggai. The people fear the Lord, and Haggai brings God's encouraging message: "I am with you," declares the Lord. On the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month they begin work on the house of the Lord Almighty.

events.title: The Glory of the Latter Temple
events.description: On the twenty-first day of the seventh month, the word of the Lord comes again through Haggai. God asks who remembers this temple in its former glory and acknowledges that it now seems like nothing. But he encourages Zerubbabel, Joshua, and the people to be strong and work, for he is with them. The Lord promises that in a little while he will shake heaven and earth, and that the treasures of all nations will come. The glory of this latter temple shall be greater than the former.

events.title: Uncleanness Spreads but Holiness Does Not
events.description: On the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, the Lord tells Haggai to ask the priests about the law: If someone carries holy meat in the fold of their garment and touches bread, wine, or other food with it, does that make them holy? The priests answer no. But if someone who is unclean because of a dead body touches something, does it become unclean? The priests answer yes. So it is with this people, says the Lord. Their uncleanness has spread to everything they offer. Yet from this day forward, God promises to bless them.

events.title: The Promise to Zerubbabel
events.description: On that same day, the twenty-fourth of the ninth month, the word of the Lord came again to Haggai with a message for Zerubbabel. God will shake heaven and earth, overthrow royal thrones, and shatter the power of nations. On that day, says the Lord Almighty, He will take Zerubbabel and make him like a signet ring, for He has chosen him. This messianic promise points forward to Christ through Zerubbabel's lineage.
